records.title: Service Costing in Government
records.publisher: Government Finance Function and HM Treasury
records.date_note: Accessed 1 November 2026. Government service-costing method is a scoped analogy, not a JGA obligation or supplier benchmark.
records.limitations: Public-service guidance supports explicit service units, assumptions and allocation logic. No government staffing ratios, on-cost percentages, financial controls or illustrative service volumes are transferred to JGA.
records.funding_or_commercial_interest: Public government service-costing guidance; not a commercial labour-rate offer or JGA cost study.
